output.sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND c.segment = 'enterprise' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC
output.explanation: Net revenue in EUR of completed orders placed in 2025 by enterprise customers, grouped by customer country, highest first. Shipping fees are excluded. Countries with no such revenue don't appear.
